entries.title: Starting point: Stand 2.9 (fix24)
entries.text: Your list of 40-odd points, read against the app. A test bench (opening, turning, pen, audio, video) runs after every change so nothing that works gets broken.

entries.title: Faster scores, steady sound, videos
entries.text: Pages on screen are drawn first and the next ones right after; page sizes are remembered. Metronome and tuner are watched every second and woken if iOS stops them; headphones get the sound, the iPad/iPhone mic stays in. Videos: All recordings button, bigger floating video, phone videos resent and never lost.

entries.title: Drones, notebooks and pages
entries.text: Drones: Organ, Soft, Bow, Horn — fuller and louder. Notebooks: side taps turn pages over photos, rotation follows the finger, the Pencil never drags a selection. Pages: hold to delete, hold and drag to reorder. Sets can use any pages.

entries.title: Import, iPhone, Find a score, backups
entries.text: Many PDFs at once with progress; better title and composer. iPhone: no Passages, Recordings scroll only up and down, iPad practice and plan arrive by themselves. Preview before adding a score. Backups are zips that open as folders: Scores (PDFs in your library folders), Recordings, Stand data.

entries.title: New covers, drawn for Stand
entries.text: All notebook covers replaced by original artwork made by a program (no downloaded photos), in the same styles: records, flowers, paint, paper, music.

entries.title: Compose and the music reader
entries.text: Marks stay when notes change, tuplets anywhere, 3/8 fixed, all clefs, tremolos, softer strings, no colliding staves, draggable slurs and hairpins, semitone arrows, cleaner transpose, 128 instruments. The reader now finds ties, slurs, triplets, staccato, accents, trills and more.

entries.title: Stand 2.10 (130)
entries.text: Full test run, version bump and the IPA.

entries.title: Stand 2.10 (131): ready to install
entries.text: The music reader now reads whole notes and half notes sitting on a line, no longer sees a head between the strokes of a final barline, and no longer takes a tuplet's 3 for a staccato dot. Everything checked again: opening and turning, pen, metronome and tuner, import of many files, backups, preview, pages, tours, iPhone recordings, Compose.
